overall.headline: Pacifica is calm today, but a king-tide storm arrives Tuesday and Wall Street fell hard Friday.
overall.bluf: Nothing needs action today. A minor Coastal Flood Advisory runs through Nov 26 and NWS expects a stormy, high-tide Tuesday–Wednesday, so prepare quietly this weekend. The S&P 500 closed in correction territory after a 3.7% drop with the VIX near 36, Russia's overnight attack sent missiles into Poland, and the Iran war remains stalled.

local.note: Minor flood advisory; storm and king tides Tue.

regional.note: Stocks in correction; Bay Area storm Tue-Wed.

changes: New: NWS Coastal Flood Advisory for the San Francisco Peninsula coast, including Pacifica, runs Nov 21 to Nov 26. A Coastal Flood Warning for the Bay shoreline begins Nov 23 (NWS).
New: KQED reports an atmospheric river with possible thunderstorms Tue Nov 24, with flooding and king tides disrupting travel Tue–Wed.
New: S&P 500 fell 3.7% Friday and, with the Dow, closed in correction; VIX rose to 35.9 (market feed, CNBC, CNN).
New: Russian missiles and a drone fell in southeast Poland Friday; Poland has not invoked NATO Article 4 (Al Jazeera).
New: CNN and NBC report the FBI is investigating a suspected breach of its NCIC criminal database; the FBI has not confirmed it.
New: Iran's Guard says it shot down US drones over Hormuz Saturday; talks to end the war remain stalled (Al Jazeera).
Dropped as stale: Pinnacles quake, Kyiv bridges item, Kataib Hezbollah deadline, UK-EU deal, Rohingya ruling, APEC item, DreamHost VPS notice (VPS only, resolved Nov 19).

coming_up.title: Rain returns
coming_up.detail: NWS: 80–90% chance Saturday afternoon and night, a tenth to a quarter inch; lighter Sunday.

coming_up.title: I-280 full closure in San Francisco; Hwy 1 one-way work
coming_up.detail: Caltrans lists a full I-280 bridge-repair closure in SF on Nov 23, and one-way traffic on Hwy 1 at Montara and Pescadero Nov 23–24. Check QuickMap first.

coming_up.title: King tides with Coastal Flood Warning for Bay shoreline
coming_up.detail: NWS expects water about 2–2.5 ft above normal high tide in Bay-side areas; advisory covers the Peninsula coast through Nov 26.

coming_up.title: Atmospheric river with possible thunderstorms
coming_up.detail: KQED, citing NWS, expects peak rain Nov 24–25 with big waves and travel disruption; drizzle ends by Thanksgiving.

home_front.summary: Minor coastal flood advisory; bigger storm and king tides Tue–Wed.

items.title: Coastal Flood Advisory for the Peninsula coast through Nov 26
items.detail: NWS San Francisco says low-lying shoreline spots may flood and some roads may close. It starts this morning; KQED says a storm and the year's highest tides combine Tue–Wed. No FEMA emergency alerts cover Pacifica.
items.action: If you live or park near the shoreline, clear storm drains and move vehicles and stored items to higher ground by Monday; don't drive around barricades.

home_front.summary: No Pacifica outage found; no DreamHost hosting incident in the window.
Hwy 1 paving at Half Moon Bay; I-280 closure in SF Mon.

items.title: Hwy 1 one-way traffic and paving south of Pacifica
items.detail: Caltrans lists one-way traffic for paving at Half Moon Bay today, lane closures there Sun–Tue, and drainage work at Montara and slide repair near Pescadero Nov 23–24. No closure inside Pacifica is listed.
items.action: Allow extra time toward Half Moon Bay; Hwy 35 or Hwy 1 north to Daly City are alternates. Storm flooding could add closures Tuesday.

home_front.summary: Air quality good (AQI 44); one California food recall.

items.title: Naia Chocolate Banana Bar Sorbetto recalled for undeclared allergens
items.detail: Naia, Inc. of Hercules, CA says the sorbetto may contain undeclared tree nuts, milk and eggs. FDA posted the notice Nov 16 and it remains in effect.

default.task: Charge phones and power banks and check flashlight batteries before Tuesday's storm.
default.why: An atmospheric river with king tides could bring outages and road closures.

3d.task: Check you have three days of drinking water, about 1 gallon per person per day.
3d.why: Storm flooding Tue–Wed can disrupt services briefly.

ladder.summary: Quiet today; storm and king tides Tue–Wed.

items.title: Bay Area storm and king tides expected Tue–Wed
items.detail: KQED, citing NWS, expects an atmospheric river with possible thunderstorms Nov 24, coastal and bayfront flooding, and disruption at airports, roads, trains and ferries ahead of Thanksgiving.
items.action: If you travel for Thanksgiving, plan to leave Monday or Wednesday evening and check flights and trains first.

items.title: Man convicted of starting the Palisades fire
items.detail: BBC reports a 30-year-old Los Angeles resident was convicted of arson over the fire that killed 12 people and destroyed more than 6,800 buildings.

ladder.summary: Stocks in correction; FBI database probe.

items.title: S&P 500 falls 3.7% into correction; VIX near 36
items.detail: The S&P 500 closed at 6,910, down 8.6% over five days, after an AI-stock sell-off; Nasdaq fell about 5% and Anthropic shares slid (CNN, BBC). Gold fell 4.6%; Brent is $92.6. The VIX above 25 is a stress signal.
items.action: No household step; avoid selling long-term savings on a single day's drop.

items.title: FBI reportedly investigating suspected breach of NCIC database
items.detail: CNN and NBC, citing two briefed people, say the bureau is probing the apparent hack of its national criminal-records database. The FBI has not confirmed scope or who is responsible; a separate FBI employee-data breach was reported in September.
items.action: No household step; watch for official statements.

items.title: CISA adds VMware vCenter, Cisco Expressway and SAP flaws to exploited list
items.detail: CISA's catalog added four actively exploited vulnerabilities on Nov 20. They affect business software, not home devices.

ladder.summary: Russian missiles fall in Poland; attacks on Ukraine continue.

items.title: Russian missiles and a drone fall in southeast Poland
items.detail: Poland's defence minister says two missiles and a jet drone landed Friday, one a Kh-101 about 50 km from the border; no injuries reported. Prime Minister Tusk called it an intentional provocation; Poland has not invoked NATO Article 4.
items.action: No household step; watch for NATO consultations.

items.title: Russia strikes Ukraine again, including Zelenskyy's hometown
items.detail: Al Jazeera reports more than 400 drones and 110 missiles overnight Friday, killing at least 8. AP via SFGate says a ballistic missile on Kryvyi Rih killed 2 and wounded 60 Saturday.
items.action: No household step; watch energy and grain prices.

ladder.summary: No major security news; strong quake near Timor-Leste.

items.title: M6.8 deep earthquake near Timor-Leste
items.detail: USGS recorded the quake at 143 km depth Saturday 09:42 UTC; GDACS rates it green, about 70,000 people felt moderate shaking. No tsunami threat to California was reported.

items.title: Nepal's new prime minister visits India
items.detail: BBC says trade, connectivity and regional cooperation top the agenda of Balendra Shah's first trip.

ladder.summary: Hormuz still disrupted; Iraq power plant fire.

items.title: Iran says it downed US drones over Hormuz; no deal to end the war
items.detail: Al Jazeera says the Guard claimed an MQ-9 and an MQ-1 on Saturday, and Iran's foreign minister calls the situation 'no war, no peace'. The strait stays disrupted; Brent is about $92.6.
items.action: Keep the car's tank at least half full if fuel prices spike.

items.title: Fire at Hartha power station in southern Iraq kills 4
items.detail: Al Jazeera reports at least four dead and 30 injured; cause not stated.

items.title: M6.7 earthquake in Peru's Andes
items.detail: USGS and AP report no damage or casualties so far.
